review_description: Found freedom solar very helpful & competitive  but went with local suppliers who also hVe a great local reputation & use similar quality products

We wanted to go with a supplier who was local and that meant Infinity Solar who have a branch in Coffs Harbour and Bellingen Solar were the final two considered.  Both were very professional and sold high quality products.The decision was close but we judged that Bellinegn Solar had been servicing the local market longer and in our opinion more likely to be still here in the future should we need service.I was pleased with the service provided by the SolarQuotes website.

I got 3 quotes and the installer that I selected was the only one that did a roof examination andworked out the northern aspect angle, the others took photographs from ground level. It seemedthat the representative had hands on experience as he came dressed for the occasion, preparedto get down and dirty.
Excellent company to deal with. High quality products, good service, and responsive to queries.

As you did not have anyone on your books in my area you did supply 3 businesses. Bellingen Solar was one of these businesses.  However, after contacting all three by email, Bellingen Solar was the only business to respond!!!  They have been very helpful and I was able (after reading your lessons) to ask about the product.  Also my partner who is an auto electrician was able to phone the owner who answered all his more difficult and technical questions eg;  can be charge batteries etc.  Thankyou for your assistance in this matter.  Regards Lorraine
